column2: A film-camera lover: moss-green bomber jacket, cargo pants, bucket hat, white sneakers and a camera around his neck.
A girl who loves vlogging: pink crop top, wide-leg pants, high ponytail, headphones and a gimbal always in hand.
A tall explorer: outdoor windbreaker, cargo pants, big hiking backpack, baseball cap, water bottle and trekking boots.
An artistic girl: oversized hoodie, pleated skirt, lavender-dyed bob, round glasses, a hand-painted tote and a sketchbook.
A city streetwear guy: graphic tee, baggy pants, sports jacket, snapback cap, headphones around his neck and a mini backpack.
